I didn't set up the Monday 08:00 digest. I posted two replies in #coastal-team's thread on your message, and the first one was wrong. It said I had no scheduler, but I do have one. I haven't created the job because I can't yet confirm it would post to this channel reliably.

Until you confirm, ask me on a Monday and I'll post the 'Coastal week ahead' digest here, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random, with open customer items. The digest will leave out money terms, since the channel is visible to the whole team.

If you want it automated, tell me to set up the scheduled job and I'll do it.
